Subject: Message to all Academic Staff - Computer Labs

KiaOra

If you would like to be part of a group who helps ITS plan and develop
the Computer Labs on campus please let me know.  It is envisaged that we
will be calling on you from time to time to discuss our plans and we
would like to incorporate any ideas or suggestions you may have to
improve the facility.

If you are unable to commit to being part of a "lab user group" but
would still like the opportunity to talk to myself and the Lab Manager
in Palmerston North about your specific requirements please let me know.
We are happy to meet with you in person to discuss these.

There is no need to re-register your interest if you are already
receiving the lab messages via email.

Thanks & kind regards

Barbie Yerkovich
ITS Manager
Massey University - Albany
Private Bag 102 904 NSMC
Auckland, New Zealand
Email: n.rfamxwqge@massey.ac.nz
Phone: +64 9 414-0800 x9476
Fax: +64 9 441-8100
